output_boundary_result.one_tile_control: No inter-output boundary exists at one tile; its -190 to 60 ns difference is retained only as measurement noise control.

interpretation.source_semantics: The production-relevant mode has one terminal PIPE_ALL after the N-major output loop. The counterfactual inserts PIPE_ALL after every IterateAll<false> call while retaining identical tiling, operand descriptors, worker population, allocation, and output order.
interpretation.conclusion: For every measured multi-output-tile cell, terminal-only execution is faster than forced per-tile drain. MatmulImpl therefore retains producer/consumer credits across the output boundary; a per-output-tile reset or complete drain is not a valid Forward mechanism.
interpretation.forward_effect: This validates the existing continuous A1/B1/L0/Cube/FixPipe max-plus recurrence direction. It adds no service value, does not change the MTE2 capacity, and cannot lower an MTE2-only probe by treating its full program duration as an overlap correction.
interpretation.next_discriminator: A future Forward change requires an independently measurable source-specific ingress mechanism beyond the already-continuous recurrence, such as a non-duration pipe-duty or queue-credit fact that distinguishes MatmulImpl ingress from the isolated MTE2-only program.

excluded_conclusions: A complete microbenchmark program duration is a production GEMM duration.
The continuous-versus-drain delta is a production residual correction.
The MTE2-only source-transition duration may be globally removed or scaled.
A per-output-tile PIPE_ALL should be inserted into Forward.
